result:
If I had the power to change the world, I would work towards achieving global equity in access to education and healthcare. These foundational elements are crucial in empowering individuals and communities, enabling them to break the cycle of poverty and inequality and contribute to the advancement of society.

Education and healthcare serve as the bedrock for people to effectively utilize their potential and, when these services are made universally accessible, they can significantly improve quality of life and overall societal well-being. A reformed system with fair access to education and healthcare would lead to a more informed and healthier global population, capable of making positive change across various sectors.
